description: A cottonwood tree with a brown trunk and drifts of soft, yellow leaves stands on a patch of bare brown earth. In parts of the composition, its twisting limbs and foliage seem to fade into the background, like clouds evaporating into the atmosphere.
title: A Memory Late Autumn
